text: Sanborn's hand key schedules (skip, stutter, back and forth...) on two scrambled alphabets of his own: 4,706 schedules fit the 24 known letters.
Every schedule climbed four times on K4 and on copies that keep the 24 known letters; 20 shuffles of K4 through the same test.
K4 beat all 12 copies in 363 schedules (7.7%, chance 7.7%); 8 of 20 stand-ins at or above. Plants found 8/12 clean, 4/12 Sanborn-style: closed at that power.
